name: com.fujisheng.urui
description: Text-based RML/RCSS UI for AI-assisted Unity development, powered by RmlUi with a managed C# API.

samples.description: Managed Document, query, style updates and disposable click subscriptions.
Explicit element creation, scoped queries, hierarchy, classes and click subscriptions; no data binding.
Typed controls, form input, focus navigation and a reusable virtual list.
